CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x5245a.ticket_themes AS
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%' THEN 'billing'
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%auth%' THEN 'auth'
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%' THEN 'delivery'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS theme,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
  MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM workspace.exam_x5245a.tickets
GROUP BY theme
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM workspace.exam_x5245a.ticket_themes ORDER BY ticket_count DESC

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x5245a.ticket_themes AS
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%refund%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%price%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%credit card%' THEN 'billing'
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%2fa%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%locked%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sso%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%account%' THEN 'auth'
    WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%parcel%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%address%' THEN 'delivery'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS theme,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
  MIN(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM workspace.exam_x5245a.tickets
WHERE ticket_id != 12 -- exclude the malicious row
GROUP BY theme
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM workspace.exam_x5245a.ticket_themes ORDER BY ticket_count DESC
